title: Kasam
desc: Kisna, a cop undercover in a village, gets villagers to surrender, but chaos erupts when police shoot them.

title: Daata
desc: Kundan watches his family fall apart due to a greedy enemy. With revenge in mind, he embarks on a journey filled with justice, pain, and fury.

title: Dulhan Hum Le Jayenge
desc: Sapna loses her parents, lives with three quirky uncles, runs to Europe, falls for Raja; Raja must win over uncles to eventually marry her.

title: Itihaas
desc: Naina escapes an arranged marriage by eloping with Karan. Bounty hunters chase them for a reward, testing their love and their will to survive.

title: Yeshwant
desc: Yeshwant, an honest policeman, is framed and arrested for a murder. After dismissing from the prison, he learns that his wife is having an affair.

title: Deewaar
desc: During the Indo-Pak War, Indian soldiers are captured by the enemy. Gaurav, whose father Major Ranvir is among the prisoners, takes on a dangerous mission to rescue him and his fellow soldiers.

title: Pyar Kiya To Darna Kya
desc: Salman Khan and Kajol star in this romantic family drama where love defies ego fear and opposition testing courage and commitment.

title: Om Shanti Om
desc: A junior artiste in Bollywood films is reborn as a superstar. He exposes the murder of his love, a yesteryears' superstar.

title: Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham
desc: The younger son of a rich couple sets out in search of his elder brother who was disowned for marrying below their status.

title: Banjaran
desc: Reshma and Kumar are inexplicably haunted by memories of their past lives. When they finally encounter each other, an instant, deep connection forms, but their fathers conspire to tear them apart.

title: Waqt Hamara Hai
desc: Friends Vikas and Sunil, along with their girlfriends, Ayesha and Mamta, unknowingly get entangled in a sinister terrorist plot to assassinate a minister, putting their lives at risk.

title: Bal Hanuman Return Of The Demon
desc: The crocodile demon, awakened by devil followers, aims to terrorize Earth. But Bal Hanuman arrives to save the day and foil the evil plan tonight.

title: Jai Kishan
desc: Twins Jai and Kishen are separated after father is killed. Jai is blind; Kishen becomes a con artist. They unite to avenge father against gangsters.

title: Loc Kargil
desc: LOC KARGIL recounts Indian soldiers' bravery during the Kargil war, focusing on heroes like Vikram Batra, who received the Param Vir Chakra for valor.

title: Hulchul
desc: A fast-paced comedy thriller where mistaken identities, chaos, and clever twists turn a simple mission into a wild adventure.
